title: Server: follower role + e2e tests
description: Follower role of the single mimid server binary: relay client submissions to remote hubs, receive notify/fanout, serve local users' KeyPackages via keyMaterial. End-to-end tests with two mimid instances on one machine (config map in place of DNS).
design:
# Plan: mimid-1wgh.7 Server follower role + e2e (APPROVED by Mark 2026-10-18)

## Scope (v1)
In: inbound POST /v1/notify (strict decode, envelope consistency, per-FanoutMessage dedup, ordered per-room log; same path serves the hub's own domain via LocalDelivery); target side of §5.2 keyMaterial (KeyPackage store: validation, single-use claim, last-resort, consent hook, recorded KeyPackageRefs for Welcome routing); relay of local clients' update/submitMessage/groupInfo/keyMaterial to the room's hub (HTTP via peer.rs, or in-process for our own hub); in-process client API for the JMAP layer (.11/.12) with a LocalUser principal; binary wiring (fanout worker with Follower as LocalDelivery, Hub peers, routes, Limitations); protocol-level 3-provider e2e.
Out: JMAP methods/objects/WSS (.11/.12.x call the follower API); agent and JMAP-driven e2e (.13, .7.1); users/tokens/ban (.32); §5.7 consent endpoints (Q8); identifierQuery; OHTTP (.8); follower Observer (Q1).

## Architecture (crates/mimid-server/src/follower/{mod,notify,key_packages,consent,relay}.rs; store/{follower_log,key_packages}.rs; migrations/0003_follower.sql with all tables)
Tables: follower_room(room_id PK, hub_domain, group_id NULL, first_seen); follower_event(seq, room_id, received_at, hub_timestamp, kind, bytes = one FanoutMessage as received, hash, UNIQUE(room_id,hash)); welcome_ref(event_seq, key_package_ref); follower_member(room_id, user_uri, since_seq, left_at); client(user_uri, client_id); key_package(ref PK, client_id, bytes, last_resort, not_after); key_package_claim(ref, user_uri, client_id, requester, room_id, claimed_at).
/notify accept_fanout(room_id, from, body) (HTTP handler and LocalDelivery both call it): body cap; NotifyRequest decode (.5.49-.5.51); From == room URI authority (Q3/Q4, consistency only); split into FanoutMessages, SHA-256 each (same hash .12.13 uses); one tx INSERT OR IGNORE in body order + follower_room upsert + welcome_ref + follower_member on claimed-ref match; 201 even if all duplicates (§5.5). Never decrypts (reads wire_format, content_type, group_id, epoch, Welcome KeyPackageRefs only). Arrival order. Decodable-but-odd -> 201 + warn (non-201 blocks the hub queue forever under H19).
keyMaterial serving: upload_key_package(&LocalUser, bytes) validates signature, suite 1, BasicCredential identity == user URI (H1), lifetime, no duplicate, <=1 last-resort per client (.12.16). serve_key_material(from, target_user, bytes): decode+verify; requestingUser == credential identity; roomId present and From == its authority (Q9); consent hook (Q8); per client atomically claim one compatible unexpired non-last-resort KP, else last-resort (not consumed), else keyMaterialExhausted/nothingCompatible; derive userStatus; record claims; unknown user -> noConsent. HTTP /v1/keyMaterial/{targetUser} dispatches by target domain (own -> follower, else hub proxy). Our hub serves local targets in-process via LocalKeyMaterial after its policy check (replaces H49 501; Q10).
Relay (follower/relay.rs): LocalUser + request bytes -> hub response bytes; hub domain = room URI authority (Q4); own domain -> in-process Hub calls with from = own domain; else PeerClient. Identity binding before any send: submitMessage sending_uri == user (the binding the hub cannot check); keyMaterial requesting_user and credential == user; groupInfo credential == user; update unchecked (MLS signature authenticates to the hub). Responses capped (MAX_BODY_LEN) and decode-checked, returned verbatim. Synchronous, no outbox (client retries; hub dedups). Accepted update / room create records follower_member. peer.rs gets generic post(domain, endpoint, var, value, body, expect); notify/key_material become wrappers; add update/submit_message/group_info.
JMAP boundary API: LocalUser (built only by JMAP auth + tests); upload/list/delete_key_package; relay_*; rooms(&LocalUser); events(&LocalUser, room_id, after_seq, limit) (seq >= since_seq while member; Welcome visible only to ref-matched users, .12.17); subscribe() broadcast (room_id, seq) for WSS; leave(&LocalUser, room_id). Hub::create_room stays on Hub (.12.4); caller records creator membership.

## Sub-beads (waves: F0 -> F1 || F2 -> F3 || F4 -> F5 -> F6)
F0 Decisions + skeleton: decision beads Q1-Q16; empty follower/*; migration 0003; store mod lines; routes /v1/notify and keyMaterial dispatch to follower stubs (501); follow() store fn. [lib.rs, http.rs, store/mod.rs, migrations]. Oracle: migration versions [1,2,3].
F1 mimi-mls M4: KeyPackage verify (signature, suite, lifetime at now), reference(), is_last_resort(), satisfies(RequiredCapabilities, suites), basic identity; Welcome::new_member_refs(). [mimi-mls wire/rfc9420.rs]. Oracle: mls-rs KeyPackages + refs; hand-built expired/bad-sig. Hostile input no panic; Read decoder only.
F2 Relay + peer generalization [peer.rs, follower/relay.rs, tests/follower_relay.rs]. Oracle: real in-process hub A + mock axum hub asserting bytes and From/Host verbatim. Tests: wrong identity rejected before any network call (mock sees 0 requests) for submit/keyMaterial/groupInfo; oversized/undecodable hub response -> typed error.
F3 Inbound /notify + follower log [follower/notify.rs, store/follower_log.rs, tests/follower_notify.rs]. Oracle: hand-encoded /notify bodies with PROVENANCE wrapping mls-rs commits/Welcomes. Tests: duplicate -> 201 and one row; wrong From refused, nothing written; non-member sees no events; canary no bodies at INFO.
F4 KeyPackage store + keyMaterial serving + LocalKeyMaterial [follower/key_packages.rs, follower/consent.rs, store/key_packages.rs, hub/key_material.rs, hub/mod.rs, tests/follower_key_material.rs]. Oracle: mls-rs KPs, response decoded with mimi-protocol, bytes verbatim. Tests: requestingUser != credential -> noConsent; From != roomId authority -> noConsent; single use across sequential and concurrent claims (§5.2 MUST); expired never served; last-resort never consumed.
F5 Wiring + Limitations [main.rs, lib.rs, http.rs router signature]. Smoke test: binary config with two peers.
F6 Three-provider e2e [tests/follower_e2e.rs, tests/common/providers.rs]: A (hub), B, C full stacks on 127.0.0.1:0; mimi-mls Members alice@A, bob@B, cathy+cathy2@C via each provider's in-process client API with an agent pump. Scenario per protocol-06 §3 figs 2-8 (create; bob KPs fetched via A->B keyMaterial; Welcome routed by ref; bob commits via B relay with cathy KPs via B->A->C; cathy sends via C; bob leaves by proposals via B, cathy commits; cathy2 external join via C). Faults: B 503 for N attempts (exactly one log entry each, hub order); B restart mid-stream (log and claims survive); origin echo exactly once (H17). Oracle: epoch_authenticator agreement, plaintext equality, bob sees own removal, per-provider streams == A's per-domain outbox, since_seq hides pre-join; an mls-rs KeyPackage served and its Welcome routed. Whole-run TRACE canary.

## Decisions (recommendations)
Q1 follower validates decode + envelope consistency, no Observer [rec]; correct the mimi-mls lib.rs doc claiming followers track an Observer; removed users at a still-member domain keep receiving ciphertext (Limitation).
Q2 dedup per FanoutMessage SHA-256 unique per room [rec] (decision + wg on §5.5 NOTE).
Q3 /notify: 201 accepted/duplicate; 400 undecodable or bad From; From != room's hub 403 INVENTED; unknown rooms accepted/created; require From to be a configured peer [rec yes].
Q4 room's hub = room URI authority (decision + wg).
Q5 relay never writes the local log; own messages return via fanout (H17) [rec].
Q6 membership: join on Welcome ref match, accepted relayed update, or room create; leave explicitly; since_seq hides pre-join history [rec].
Q7 clientUri = mimi://<domain>/d/<base32(SHA-256(leaf signature key))> INVENTED [rec]; add to wg 37.67.
Q8 consent v1: implicit allow + one consent::allows hook; unknown user -> noConsent; §5.7 endpoints a later bead [rec].
Q9 target-provider keyMaterial checks: signature; requestingUser == credential identity; roomId present (absent -> noConsent); From == roomId authority (decision + wg).
Q10 supersede H49's local-target 501: hub serves local targets in-process via LocalKeyMaterial after its policy check.
Q11 ownership/deps: .7 owns KeyPackage schema, upload validation, /notify dedup; .12.3/.12.6 shrink to JMAP mapping; remove .7 deps on .11, .12.6, .2; add .12.3->F4, .12.6->F3, .12.5/.12.7/.12.8->F2; .7.1 keeps .12.7, .12.8, .13.
Q12 JMAP authenticates bearer -> LocalUser; relay.rs is the single place checking which identities a LocalUser may claim (confirm fits one-authorization-point rule).
Q13 keep .12.16 last-resort reuse as documented deviation from §5.2 'MUST NOT be provided in any other response' + wg (RFC 9420 §16.8 tension).
Q14 claims kept until a Welcome matches or KP not_after passes; cleanup ponytail.
Q15 relay synchronous, no outbox; peer failure -> typed error mapped by JMAP.
Q16 arrival order, no timestamp reordering (Limitation; non-mimid hubs may pipeline).

## Risks
F4/F5 edit hub files and main.rs (start after hub lands — it has); permanent refusals (400/403) stall a hub's (room,domain) queue under H19 (operators must see it); fanout can race relay response (handled by Q3 + Q6); storage growth from configured peers (no retention); mls-rs oracle limited to KPs/refs; SQLite contention (don't hold hub lock H7 across follower writes); trust model weak (no Observer, BasicCredential, unauthenticated From) — consistency checks only; spec churn in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (note on .12 if shapes change).
notes: 2026-10-18: F-Q5 superseded by mimid-1wgh.7.30; follow-up mimid-1wgh.7.31.
